name: 50112 · Grinnell, IA
findings: ZIP 50112 (Grinnell) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50112 (Grinnell) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 50112 (Grinnell) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).
